source_text: Hircus in eremum portat iniquitates. Christus tulit peccata in corpus suum. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Goat into desert carries iniquities. Christ bore sins in body his. Amen.
pass_b_english: The [[goat into the wilderness carries iniquities >> Bible:Leviticus 16:22]]. Christ [[bore our sins in his body >> Bible:1 Peter 2:24]]. Homilia X CLOSEOUT. Amen.
